title: Post-Construction Cleaning in Abuja: Why Moving Into a New Home Without It is a Risk
excerpt: Don't move into dust and debris! Discover why professional post-construction cleaning is essential for your family's health and your new home's longevity.

children.text: Construction dust isn't like regular house dust. It's a toxic cocktail of fine silica, paint fumes, and chemical solvents. Standard mopping won't remove these hazards.

body.alt: Standard cleaning doesn't remove construction dust
Industrial cleaning equipment for construction sites

body.name: faq
body.question: Can't I just do this myself with a broom and mop?
body.answer: Absolutely not. Household vacuums blow fine silica dust back into the air. You need HEPA-filtered industrial equipment to safely remove construction debris.
